retrievalProfile.description: A minimalist composition featuring a narrow horizontal landscape strip bisecting a vast dark field with centered serif text at the top and bottom poles.

recipe.visualDefinition: A stark, dark square canvas dominated by deep charcoal or black, interrupted only by a thin horizontal band of a surrealist landscape and small blocks of centered white serif text at the extreme top and bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Extreme vertical symmetry in text placement
Horizontal landscape band as the primary focal point
High contrast between dark field and vibrant landscape colors
Scale contrast between tiny text and vast empty space
coreInvariants: The landscape must be contained within a narrow horizontal strip
Text must be centered and set in a classical serif
The background must be a solid, dark, textured field

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A narrow horizontal landscape strip occupies the center third of the vertical axis, spanning the full width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The horizontal landscape band acts as the central anchor against the dark void.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top text, drops to the central landscape strip, and finishes at the bottom text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant; approximately 80% of the composition is empty dark space.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Yellow, purple, and blue within the landscape strip
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the central strip against zero saturation in the surrounding field.
paletteRestrictions: Landscape should use a limited surrealist palette

letterConstructionRules: Small caps or all caps for hierarchy
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used for both top and bottom text blocks to maintain symmetry.

candidateDirections.reason: Classic proportions and elegant serifs match the literary tone.
Provides a traditional, authoritative feel suitable for the theme.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square image with a solid dark charcoal textured background. In the center, place a narrow horizontal strip containing a surrealist landscape with long shadows, yellow ground, and purple hills.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add centered white serif text in all caps at the top and bottom margins, ensuring generous padding from the central landscape strip.

verificationChecks: Is the landscape restricted to a narrow horizontal band?
Is the background a solid dark color?
Is the font a classical serif?

adjustableVariables: Specific color palette of the landscape
mustRedesign: Do not allow the landscape to bleed into the text areas

mustAchieve: Perfect vertical centering of text blocks
Clean horizontal edges on the landscape strip
High contrast between text and background

postGenerationChecks: Check for text legibility against the dark background
Verify the landscape strip is perfectly horizontal
Ensure the negative space feels intentional and vast
recipe.reuseFormula: Dark Square + Centered Serif Text (Top/Bottom) + Central Horizontal Landscape Strip = Surrealist Minimalist Layout
